headline: Red Sox Batters Explode For Fifteen Hits In Blowout Win At Fenway
morning_brew: What a difference a day makes at Fenway Park. After a quiet night, the bats exploded for fifteen hits in an eight to one blowout win over Baltimore. Payton Tolle was absolutely fantastic on the mound, tossing six scoreless innings with five strikeouts to earn the win. Wilyer Abreu provided the big spark with a two-run homer and three runs batted in, while Willson Contreras and Ceddanne Rafaela paced the offense with three hits apiece. Even Mickey Gasper drove in a pair of runs, making this a complete team victory.

The win brings the club to twenty-six and thirty-four, and they have a career opportunity to take the series this afternoon before heading down the Pike for a massive weekend clash in New York. We all know how important these games against the Yankees are, and we cannot afford to head to the Bronx with any lingering bad habits. I been sayin' it all year, this division is a gauntlet, so every single win matters if they want to dig themselves out of the basement.

Meanwhile, as the Celtics and Bruins sit in their off-seasons, the Patriots are generating buzz with early projections. The football index has its ratings live, but those computer simulations do not mean a thing once the pads come on. With A.J. Brown already making his presence felt at practice, my focus is entirely on how this new-look offense clicks when it actually counts. June is for speculation, but real results are all that matter in this town.

news_digest.headline: Abreu has a two-run homer and 3 RBIs, Tolle pitches 6 scoreless innings and Red Sox beat Orioles 8-1
news_digest.dans_take: That is how you bounce back and show some real life at Fenway.

news_digest.headline: Red Sox and Orioles play, winner takes 3-game series
news_digest.dans_take: The rubber match is huge before we head down to New York.
